lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: Walk me through the plan one more time.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: We enter through the vents of fate.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: There are no vents. It's a single-storey building.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Then we enter through the door of fate.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: Every door is a door of fate if you believe hard enough.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: What's the fallback if the alarm trips?

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: I need an exit strategy, not a mantra.

lines.speaker: cultist
lines.text: The exit strategy is the same as the entrance strategy, reversed.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: That's just walking out the door.

lines.speaker: bosscop
lines.text: I'm bringing someone else next time.
